answer: Cap identity churn. Each epoch the network admits new identities only up to 2% of its established count, through a public queue that flows like a river through a lock: steady, never in a flood. Newcomers then ramp from 10% to full weight over ten epochs, and any identity that exits forfeits its ramp. A farm trying to gale in a thousand fake names waits in line for months, while honest agents trickle in as before. Admission records are carved like onyx, permanent and auditable, so bursts tied to one sponsor are easy to spot.
